t Kabel
is a
hamlet
in the
Dutch
province of
North Holland
. It is a part of the municipality of
Haarlemmermeer
, and lies just southeast of
Nieuw-Vennep
and about 6 km southwest of
Hoofddorp
.
Kabel has a population of around 100.
